name: Jones Berry Farm
tagline: Link to Jones Berry Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/jonesberryfarm/
description: In Salem, AR, Jones Berry Farm raises Strawberries and Blueberries on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
